moworks.notes: Two bands share a centre line c(x) (drifting +-8 px with the phase): A above, B below. Thickness along x is a smooth sine shape that blends by a phase: A 4-28 -> 20-40 px, B 18-38 -> 6-22 px (the shares swap). Phase: hold 0 to 400 ms, -> 1 at 1800, hold to 2600, back to 0 at 4000 ms, easeInOut. Boundary stroked 1.5 px in the background colour, never jumps. Readout at ~71 % of the width: A % / B % with dots on the edges. Params: phase (0 → 1 → 0) · duration (4 s) · colors A / B.
